title: Agent Card extension entry
description: One entry in the Agent Card's capabilities.extensions[] array advertising the Agentforce Live profile (spec §4). For v0.1 'required' MUST be false.

required.description: The extension is optional; Agent Cards MUST set required=false for v0.1 (spec §4.1).

directiveTypes.description: Directive types the Reasoner can emit (spec §4.2).
